query: Do federal judges appointed by different Presidents (Trump vs. other Republican vs. Democratic) differ in their voting tendencies on immigration injunction cases? Do Trump-appointed judges tend to be more supportive of Trump administration immigration policies compared to judges appointed by other Republican or Democratic presidents?

schema.name: judge_name
schema.definition: The full name of the presiding federal judge who issued the decision.
schema.rationale: Necessary to identify the specific judge and subsequently cross-reference their appointing President.

schema.name: appointing_president
schema.definition: The U.S. President who appointed the judge to the federal bench.
schema.rationale: Directly addresses the core query comparing Trump-appointed judges with those appointed by other Republican or Democratic presidents.

schema.name: appointing_president_party
schema.definition: The political party of the President who appointed the judge.
schema.rationale: Allows grouping of judges by political party (Democratic vs. Republican) to analyze broader voting tendencies.

schema.name: ruling_on_immigration_policy
schema.definition: The judge's ruling or voting stance on the challenged immigration policy or injunction.
schema.rationale: Directly measures the judge's voting tendency and supportiveness toward the administration's immigration policies.
allowed_values: Supportive of challenge / Against administration policy
Against challenge / Supportive of administration policy
Mixed / Granted in part and denied in part

schema.name: challenged_administration
schema.definition: The presidential administration whose immigration policy is being challenged in the case.
schema.rationale: Helps determine if Trump-appointed judges are specifically more supportive of Trump administration policies compared to other administrations' policies.

schema.name: case_outcome_injunction
schema.definition: The court's decision regarding the requested preliminary injunction or stay.
schema.rationale: Identifies the specific legal outcome of the immigration injunction request.
allowed_values: Granted in part and denied in part
